wrong_findings.claim: “Pages have unique titles, descriptions and canonicals.”
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The site has duplicate titles on /coffee/ and /subscriptions/, no meta description on /about/, no canonical on /contact/, and /shop/ canonicalizes to /coffee/.

wrong_findings.claim: “Every page has a unique, sensible <title>, apart from the duplicate in issue 12.”
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The titles are not all unique: /coffee/ and /subscriptions/ share the same title, which the audit itself identifies.
